programs.desc: Host Johanna Griggs, with the help of the team - Patrick Thompson, Candy Day, Will Dangar, Luke Dyer and Jason Hodges - bring an outmoded house into the 21st century. Ancient carpet is replaced to brighten the entry and dining area. Outside, the team create a tropical exotic atmosphere perfect for al fresco dining.
